title: The + menu offers "Work on a repository"
steps: Sign in as the test admin
Open a new chat (assistant, Agent mode, agent harness on)
Open the composer + menu
expected: A row "Work on a repository" with the subtitle "Clone a GitHub repository into this chat"
The row is enabled (not aria-disabled)

title: Greyed: this chat has no coding engine
steps: Sign in as the test admin
Open a new chat
Send "/engine none" from the composer
Open the + menu
Type "/repo" in the composer
expected: The row is greyed with the subtitle "Needs a coding engine. Pick one first."
/repo is greyed with the same reason

title: Greyed: the organization has no coding engine turned on
steps: Sign in as the test admin
Stub only GET /api/v1/agent-harness/model-accounts/coding-engine so every engine is unavailable
Open a new chat and the + menu
expected: The row is greyed with the subtitle "Your organization hasn't turned on coding engines."

title: Greyed: the chat already works on a repository
steps: Sign in as the test admin
Send a first message in a new chat and wait for the answer
Open the + menu, pick acme/widgets from main, "Use repository" (PUT …/repository)
Reload the chat and open the + menu
Remove it with the chip's ×
expected: The chip "acme/widgets from main" shows over the composer (not copied yet)
The row is greyed: "This chat already works on acme/widgets. Start a new chat for another repository."
After ×, the chip is gone and the row is enabled again

title: The picker lists repositories, searches, and marks the default branch
steps: Sign in as the test admin
Open a new chat, + menu, "Work on a repository"
Search "widgets" and pick acme/widgets
Open "Start from branch"
expected: The GitHub connection select shows "GitHub"
Three repositories, acme/widgets tagged "private", each with "updated …"
Searching "widgets" leaves two
The branch select shows "main (default)" and offers release/1.x
The "What happens" note names acme/widgets and main

title: No GitHub connection: "Connect GitHub first"
steps: Sign in as the test member (no GitHub connection)
Open a new chat and send "/engine opencode" from the composer (the member has no default engine)
Open the + menu, "Work on a repository"
Click "Connect GitHub"
expected: The warning "Connect GitHub first. PipesHub uses your GitHub connection to copy the repository and push the engine's branch." with Cancel and Connect GitHub
Connect GitHub opens /workspace/actions/personal?toolsetType=github

title: A new chat: the chip before the first message
steps: Sign in as the test admin
Open a new chat, pick acme/widgets from main and "Use repository"
Type "/repo"
Click the chip's ×
expected: The chip "acme/widgets from main" with × ("Don't use this repository") sits over the composer
/repo is greyed: the chat already works on acme/widgets
× removes the chip

title: Activity rows of an engine turn: copied, pushed, pull request
steps: Needs PXH_REPO_ENGINE_TURN and a cloneable repository (skipped otherwise)
Sign in as the test admin
Open a new chat, pick acme/widgets from main
Ask the engine to change README.md, push its branch and open a pull request
expected: "Copied acme/widgets · branch pipeshub/session-…"
"Pushed to pipeshub/session-…"
"Opened pull request #N in acme/widgets" with "View on GitHub"
No JSON, ids or raw command output in those rows; a refused push is one row "Couldn't push to <target> · <reason>"
